verse.text: To discipline a child produces wisdom, but a mother is disgraced by an undisciplined child.

video.title: Five-Minute Fatherhood Talks - 03 Discipline and Fatherhood

reflection: Discipline isn't about anger or control — it's one of the clearest ways we show our kids they're loved enough to be guided. A dad who corrects with patience, follows through on consequences, and stays calm in the moment is teaching his child wisdom that will outlast any argument. It's slow, unglamorous work, but it's exactly the kind of steady love that shapes a child's character for life.
